title: Insurer Program Agreements Tiers, Volume Commitments and Agreement Term
content:
The Insurer Program Agreements run in six tiers, ranked from 1 to 6. Each tier is entered on a stated program and volume commitment and carries its own term, renewal and notice figures.

## Tier ladder and entry

| Rank | Agreement tier | Program | Volume commitment on entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Network Referral Agreement | Referral listing only, insurer appraises every claim | None |
| 2 | Select Direct Repair Agreement | Direct repair | At least the tier commitment |
| 3 | Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | Direct repair | At least the tier commitment |
| 4 | Premier Direct Repair Agreement | Direct repair with guaranteed acceptance | At least the tier commitment |
| 5 | Managed Repair Program Agreement | Network appraises and manages repairs on the insurer's behalf | At least the tier commitment |
| 6 | Enterprise Master Services Agreement | National master agreement covering repair, glass and total-loss handling | At least the tier commitment |

## Term figures by tier

| Agreement tier | Annual volume commitment (assignments) | Re-rated at renewal on a shortfall | Agreement year (calendar months) | Renews automatically | Termination notice (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | 0 | No | 12 | Yes | 30 |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | 250 | Yes | 12 | Yes | 30 |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 750 | Yes | 12 | Yes | 60 |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 2000 | Yes | 24 | Yes | 60 |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | 5000 | Yes | 36 | Yes | 90 |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 15000 | Yes | 36 | Yes | 120 |

## What each figure means

- **Annual volume commitment** — the assignments per agreement year the insurer commits to (a whole number; 0 means none).
- **Re-rated at renewal on a shortfall** — whether an agreement whose assignments in the year fell short of the commitment is re-rated at renewal to the highest tier whose commitment was met.
- **Agreement year** — the calendar months of each agreement year (a whole number).
- **Renews automatically** — whether the agreement renews automatically at the end of its term unless notice is given.
- **Termination notice** — the calendar days between a termination notice and the termination date (a whole number).

## Questions on the figures

**Does a Network Referral Agreement carry a volume commitment?** No; its commitment is 0, defined as none, and its entry requires no commitment.

**How long is the agreement year under a Premier Direct Repair Agreement?** 24 calendar months; under the Managed and Enterprise tiers, 36; under the three lower tiers, 12.

**Which tiers give 60 calendar days between a termination notice and the termination date?** The Preferred and Premier Direct Repair Agreements.
